page_title: Analyze, review, and edit your app translations with Loca Studio

sources.entry: Loca Studio - Analyze, review, and edit app translations.

summary.name: Loca Studio
summary.one_liner: A free macOS app for analyzing, reviewing, and editing app translations across a folder of Xcode Localization Catalog (xcloc) or XLIFF files.
use_cases: Checking format string placeholders in localized strings
Finding translations in the wrong language
Editing Xcode xcloc or XLIFF files in bulk
summary.what_it_does: Loca Studio is a macOS app that opens a whole folder of Xcode Localization Catalog (xcloc) or XLIFF files. It runs automatic QA checks, including static analysis of format string placeholders and checks that source and target types match, with support for printf formats, Apple extensions, and stringsdict plurals. A terminology check highlights glossary terms, and a language check flags translations that appear to be in the wrong language. It also offers character-level diffs of changed translation units, search and filtering, and import/export to Excel.
notable: Automatic QA checks for format string placeholders and stringsdict plurals
Multilingual iOS 14 glossary covering 39 languages via Loca Term
Character-level diff and merge of translation units
Universal app for Apple silicon and Intel Macs, ready for macOS Monterey
caveats: Page does not describe any paid tier beyond calling the app free
